title: Noor and the Extraction
author: Lena Blackwood
blurb: Oscar Quintana, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, works cases no one wants attributed. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
